Implemented FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task and it compiled successfully on the first attempt (CODESYS: 0 errors, 0 warnings).

Behavior implemented:
- Error := (Target < 1) OR (Target > 20) — exact validation.
- If Error OR Reset: Count := 0, Complete := FALSE (safety priority, overrides counting).
- Otherwise: on a FALSE→TRUE PartPulse transition (PartPulse AND NOT qPulse) increment Count only while Count < Target (saturation/clamping at Target); Complete := (Count >= Target), so a higher Target clears it.
- qPulse := PartPulse is executed every scan, including reset and invalid-target scans, so a held-high sensor after reset produces no phantom count.
- State: qPulse : BOOL := FALSE; Count/Complete/Error are outputs (Count starts at 0 on instance reset).

Interface preserved exactly: inputs PartPulse (BOOL), Reset (BOOL), Target (USINT); outputs Count (USINT), Complete (BOOL), Error (BOOL). No supporting objects required.

Note: only compilation was performed; no PLC functional/runtime tests were executed.
